signature.name: VTask.lp
signature.type: {α : Type u_3} -> (E : α → Type u_5) -> [(i : α) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] -> (p : ENNReal) -> AddSubgroup (PreLp E)

conventions.statement: When α is a Fintype, every function f : Π i, E i satisfies Memℓp f p for all p ∈ ℝ≥0∞, so VTask.lp E p equals all of PreLp E.
conventions.note: Standard consequence of finiteness; no special junk value, just a degenerate case.

conventions.statement: A function belongs to VTask.lp E 0 if and only if it has finite support (finitely many nonzero coordinates), regardless of the norms of those coordinates.
conventions.note: The Memℓp predicate at p = 0 counts nonzero entries rather than summing norms.

conventions.statement: A function belongs to VTask.lp E ⊤ if and only if the supremum of ‖f i‖ over all i is finite.
conventions.note: The Memℓp predicate at p = ∞ is a boundedness condition.

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (E : α → Type*) [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] (p : ENNReal) (f g : PreLp E), f ∈ VTask.lp E p → g ∈ VTask.lp E p → f + g ∈ VTask.lp E p

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (E : α → Type*) [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] (p : ENNReal) (f : PreLp E), f ∈ VTask.lp E p → -f ∈ VTask.lp E p

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (E : α → Type*) [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] (p : ENNReal), (VTask.lp E p : AddSubgroup (PreLp E)).toAddSubmonoid ≤ ⊤

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (E : α → Type*) [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] (p : ENNReal) (f g : PreLp E), f ∈ VTask.lp E p → g ∈ VTask.lp E p → f - g ∈ VTask.lp E p
